$description: Maps Unity version ranges to compatible Unity MCP versions. Used by install-unity-mcp.ps1 and AI agents.
$maintainer: Update this file when new Unity MCP versions are released or new Unity versions are tested.

offline_install.$description: Offline install config. Use -Local or -Embedded mode for sandbox/air-gapped environments.
offline_install.instructions: Run package-unity-mcp.ps1 on a networked machine to generate .tgz, then copy to target and use install-unity-mcp.ps1 -Local to install

version_map.notes: Unity 6+ uses new BuildReport API; v9.6.x required
v9.6.x has compile error on 2022.3 (BuildReport.SummarizeErrors is Unity 6+ only)

known_issues.issue: BuildReport.SummarizeErrors() API does not exist; conditional compilation macro is wrong (#if UNITY_2022_3_OR_NEWER should be #if UNITY_6000_0_OR_NEWER)
